# Attach libraries
require(dplyr)
require(Seurat)
require(ggplot2)


## Graphical parameters
axis.text.color = "black"
line.color = "black"
bkg.plot = element_blank()

expression_palette = viridis::viridis(10, direction = 1)

umap_theme = theme(aspect.ratio = 1,
                   axis.line = element_line(arrow = grid::arrow(type = "closed", ends = "last"), color = line.color),
                   axis.ticks = element_blank(),
                   axis.text = element_blank(),
                   axis.title = element_text(hjust = 0.90, color = axis.text.color),
                   panel.background = element_blank(),
                   plot.background = element_blank(),
                   legend.text = element_text(color = axis.text.color),
                   legend.background = bkg.plot,
                   legend.title = bkg.plot,
                   plot.title = ggtext::element_markdown(hjust = 0.5, color = axis.text.color),
                   plot.subtitle = ggtext::element_markdown(hjust = 0.5, color = axis.text.color))

colors_tissue_type =
  c("Primary Breast" = "pink2",
    "Recurrent Breast" = "pink4",
    "Breast angiosarcoma" = "firebrick",
    "Malignant Pleural Effusion" = "purple",
    "Lymph Nodes" = "steelblue",
    "Ovarian" = "darkorange2",
    "Myometrium" = "orange",
    "Liver" = "chocolate4",
    "Neural" = "gold3",
    "Skin" = "forestgreen")



colors_cell_type_major =
  c("Cancer Epithelial" = "firebrick",
    "B-cells" = "magenta4",
    "T-cells" = "steelblue4",
    "Plasmablasts" = "darkorange2",
    "Myeloid" = "gold3",
    "PVL" = "chocolate4",
    "Endothelial" = "forestgreen",
    "CAFs" = "plum3",
    "Normal Epithelial" = "#276B60",
    "NA" = "gray")


colors_cell_type_minor =
  c(# Cancer Epithelial (5 subtypes → gradient of firebrick)
    "Cancer Basal SC"             = "#F7B2B2",
    "Cancer Cycling"              = "#EC6A6A",
    "Cancer Her2 SC"              = "#CC0000",
    "Cancer LumA SC"              = "#800000",
    "Cancer LumB SC"              = "#4D0000",
    
    # B-cells (2 subtypes → light + dark magenta4)
    "B cells Memory"              = "#B874B8",
    "B cells Naive"               = "#8B008B",
    
    # T-cells (5 subtypes → gradient of steelblue4)
    "Cycling T-cells"             = "#97B2CC",
    "NK cells"                    = "#5C89B2",
    "NKT cells"                   = "#306B99",
    "T cells CD4+"                = "#184F73",
    "T cells CD8+"                = "#0B314D",
    
    # Plasmablasts (single subtype → darkorange2)
    "Plasmablasts"                = "#FF8C00",
    
    # Myeloid (4 subtypes → gradient of gold3)
    "Cycling_Myeloid"             = "#F9E39C",
    "DCs"                         = "#E6C44D",
    "Macrophage"                  = "#CC9900",
    "Monocyte"                    = "#806600",
    
    # PVL (3 subtypes → gradient of chocolate4)
    "Cycling PVL"                 = "#B68C6E",
    "PVL Differentiated"          = "#8C5E3C",
    "PVL Immature"                = "#5C3A20",
    
    # Endothelial (4 subtypes → gradient of forestgreen)
    "Endothelial ACKR1"           = "#B6E0B6",
    "Endothelial CXCL12"          = "#73C173",
    "Endothelial Lymphatic LYVE1" = "#339933",
    "Endothelial RGS5"            = "#196619",
    
    # CAFs (2 subtypes → light + dark plum3)
    "CAFs MSC iCAF-like"          = "#BC9BC7",
    "CAFs myCAF-like"             = "#9370DB",
    
    # Normal epithelial (3 subtypes → gradient of aquamarine4)
    "Luminal Progenitors"         = "#79D4C6",
    "Mature Luminal"              = "#41968A",
    "Myoepithelial"               = "#276B60",
    
    # Unknown
    "NA" = "gray"
  )


colors_cancer_cells_minor =
  c(# Cancer Epithelial (5 subtypes → gradient of firebrick)
    "Cancer Basal SC" = "forestgreen",
    "Cancer Cycling"  = "purple1",
    "Cancer Her2 SC"  = "steelblue4",

1 Load Seurat object

xenium -> readRDS("./xenium_all_TMAs_combined.Rds")
xenium


1.1 Coohort overview

## Data summary
summary_types <-
  unique(xenium@meta.data %>%
           dplyr::select(M.nr, Donor.Block.ID, Tissue_type)) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(M.nr),
                !is.na(Tissue_type)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Tissue_type = factor(Tissue_type,
                                     levels = rev(names(colors_tissue_type)))) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(M.nr, Tissue_type) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n = n())
 


n.samples.per.type <-
  unique(xenium@meta.data %>%
           dplyr::select(M.nr, Donor.Block.ID, Tissue_type)) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(M.nr),
                !is.na(Tissue_type)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Tissue_type) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(tot = n()) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Tissue_type = factor(Tissue_type,
                                     levels = rev(names(colors_tissue_type))))




## Plotting
data_origin <-
  ggplot(data = summary_types,
       aes(x = gsub("M-","",M.nr),
           y = Tissue_type,
           color = Tissue_type)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = n), stroke = NA, show.legend = F) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors_tissue_type, guide = "none") +
  scale_size_continuous(breaks = 1:20, range = c(5,10)) +
  #geom_text(aes(label = ER_primary_symbol), color = "white", vjust = 0.4) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), color = "white", vjust = 0.4, size = 2) +
  scale_x_discrete(position = "top") +
  ylab(NULL) +
  xlab(NULL) +
  theme_light() +
  theme(axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black"))


bar_plot = 
  ggplot(data = as.data.frame(n.samples.per.type),
         aes(x = tot,
             y = Tissue_type,
             fill = Tissue_type)) +
  geom_bar(color = NA, position = "dodge", stat = "identity", show.legend = F) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors_tissue_type, guide = "none") +
  xlab(NULL) +
  ylab(NULL) +
  theme_classic() +
  geom_text(aes(label = tot),
            hjust = 1.5,
            color = "White") +
  ggbreak::scale_x_break(c(21,21), expand = c(0,0), scales = 0.2) +
  scale_x_continuous(position = "top") +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0,0)) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black"),
        axis.line.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        axis.line.x.bottom = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x.bottom = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x.bottom = element_blank())


dotplot_bar <- patchwork::wrap_plots(data_origin, ggplotify::as.ggplot(~print(bar_plot)),
                                     nrow = 1, widths = c(1.5, 0.25))

dotplot_bar


2 UMAPs

2.1 Cell categories

umap_all_tissue_MNr =
  Seurat::DimPlot(xenium,
                  group.by = "M.nr",
                  raster=TRUE,
                  raster.dpi = c(800,800)) + # passed to geom_scattermore() for rasterization
  xlab("UMAP1") +
  ylab("UMAP2") +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors_mnr,
                     breaks = names(colors_mnr)) +
  ggtitle(label = "**All cells | Patient**",
          subtitle = paste0("*n* = ", prettyNum(nrow(xenium@meta.data), big.mark = ","))) +
  umap_theme
  


umap_all_tissue_types =
  Seurat::DimPlot(xenium,
                  group.by = "Tissue_type",
                  raster = TRUE,
                  raster.dpi = c(800,800)) + # passed to geom_scattermore() for rasterization
  xlab("UMAP1") +
  ylab("UMAP2") +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors_tissue_type,
                     breaks = names(colors_tissue_type)) +
  ggtitle(label = "**All cells | Tissue origin**",
          subtitle = paste0("*n* = ", prettyNum(nrow(xenium@meta.data), big.mark = ","))) +
  umap_theme



umap_all_cell_types_major =
  Seurat::DimPlot(xenium,
                  group.by = "Major_cell_annotation",
                  raster = TRUE,
                  raster.dpi = c(800,800)) + # passed to geom_scattermore() for rasterization
  xlab("UMAP1") +
  ylab("UMAP2") +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors_cell_type_major,
                     breaks = names(colors_cell_type_major)) +
  ggtitle(label = "**All cells | cell type (major)**",
          subtitle = paste0("*n* = ", prettyNum(nrow(xenium@meta.data), big.mark = ","))) +
  umap_theme



umap_all_cell_types_minor =
  Seurat::DimPlot(xenium,
                  group.by = "Minor_cell_annotation",
                  raster = TRUE,
                  raster.dpi = c(800,800)) + # geom_scattermore() for rasterization
  xlab("UMAP1") +
  ylab("UMAP2") +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors_cell_type_minor,
                     breaks = names(colors_cell_type_minor)) +
  ggtitle(label = "**All cells | cell type (minor)**",
          subtitle = paste0("*n* = ", prettyNum(nrow(xenium@meta.data), big.mark = ","))) +
  umap_theme



umap_all_n.genes =
  Seurat::FeaturePlot(xenium,
                    features = "nFeature_Xenium",
                    reduction = "umap",
                    raster = TRUE,
                    raster.dpi = c(800, 800), # geom_scattermore() for rasterization
                    max.cutoff = "q90") +
  viridis::scale_color_viridis(limits = c(0,quantile(xenium@meta.data$nFeature_Xenium,0.9)),
                               guide = "colorbar",
                               na.value = viridis::viridis(10)[10]) +
  xlab("UMAP1") +
  ylab("UMAP2") +
  ggtitle(label = "**All cells | N genes per cell**",
          subtitle = paste0("*n* = ", prettyNum(nrow(xenium@meta.data), big.mark = ","))) +
  umap_theme


all_umaps <-
  patchwork::wrap_plots(umap_all_tissue_MNr, umap_all_tissue_types,
                        umap_all_cell_types_major, umap_all_cell_types_minor,
                        umap_all_n.genes)
all_umaps


3 Other quality controls

3.1 Gene counts distribution

## Genes per cell
genes_per_cell_meta = xenium@meta.data


global_gene_distr =
  ggplot(data = genes_per_cell_meta,
         aes(x = nFeature_Xenium)) +
  geom_density(fill = "#69b3a2", color = NA, alpha = 1, stat = "count") +
  ylab("# Cells") +
  xlab("# Detected genes") +
  ggtitle("Global gene count distribution") +
  annotate(geom = "text",
           label = paste0("median = ",median(genes_per_cell_meta$nFeature_Xenium)),
           x = +Inf, y = +Inf,
           hjust = 1.5, vjust = 1.5) +
  annotate(geom = "text",
           label = paste0("mean = ",round(mean(genes_per_cell_meta$nFeature_Xenium), 1)),
           x = +Inf, y = +Inf,
           hjust = 1.5, vjust = 3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = mean(genes_per_cell_meta$nFeature_Xenium),
             linetype = 2, color = "gray") +
  geom_boxplot(data = data.frame(y = -250, x = genes_per_cell_meta$nFeature_Xenium),
               aes(x = x, y = y), inherit.aes = F, width = 200, outlier.stroke = NA, outlier.alpha = 0.5) +
  ggpubr::theme_pubr()


gene_distr_per_tissue_type =
  ggplot(data = genes_per_cell_meta %>%
           dplyr::mutate(Tissue_type = factor(Tissue_type, levels = rev(names(colors_tissue_type)))),
         aes(y = Tissue_type,
             x = nFeature_Xenium)) +
  geom_violin(aes(fill = Tissue_type),
              color = NA,
              position = position_dodge()) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "white", width = 0.1, position = position_dodge(),
               outlier.stroke = NA, outlier.alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors_tissue_type) +
  xlab("# Detected genes per cell") +
  ylab(NULL) +
  ggpubr::theme_pubr(legend = "none") +
  theme(axis.ticks.y = element_blank())



gene_distr_per_cell_type_major =
  ggplot(data = genes_per_cell_meta %>%
           dplyr::mutate(Major_cell_annotation = factor(Major_cell_annotation, levels = rev(names(colors_cell_type_major)))),
         aes(y = Major_cell_annotation,
             x = nFeature_Xenium)) +
  geom_violin(aes(fill = Major_cell_annotation),
              color = NA,
              position = position_dodge()) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "white", width = 0.1, position = position_dodge(),
               outlier.stroke = NA, outlier.alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors_cell_type_major) +
  xlab("# Detected genes per cell") +
  ylab(NULL) +
  ggpubr::theme_pubr(legend = "none") +
  theme(axis.ticks.y = element_blank())



gene_distr_per_cell_type_minor =
  ggplot(data = genes_per_cell_meta %>%
           dplyr::mutate(Minor_cell_annotation = factor(Minor_cell_annotation, levels = rev(names(colors_cell_type_minor)))),
         aes(y = Minor_cell_annotation,
             x = nFeature_Xenium)) +
  geom_violin(aes(fill = Minor_cell_annotation),
              color = NA,
              position = position_dodge()) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "white", width = 0.1, position = position_dodge(),
               outlier.stroke = NA, outlier.alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors_cell_type_minor) +
  xlab("# Detected genes per cell") +
  ylab(NULL) +
  ggpubr::theme_pubr(legend = "none") +
  theme(axis.ticks.y = element_blank())


gene_distr_per_patient =
  ggplot(data = genes_per_cell_meta %>%
           dplyr::mutate(M.nr = factor(M.nr, levels = rev(names(colors_mnr)))),
         aes(y = M.nr,
             x = nFeature_Xenium)) +
  geom_violin(aes(fill = M.nr),
              color = NA,
              position = position_dodge()) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "white", width = 0.1, position = position_dodge(),
               outlier.stroke = NA, outlier.alpha = 0.5) +

  ylab(NULL) +

global_cell.type.major = patchwork::wrap_plots(global_gene_distr,
                                               gene_distr_per_tissue_type,
                                               gene_distr_per_cell_type_major,
                                               ncol = 1, heights = c(0.2,1, 1))

global_cell.type.major_minor_patient = patchwork::wrap_plots(global_cell.type.major,
                                                             gene_distr_per_cell_type_minor,
                                                             gene_distr_per_patient,
                                                             nrow = 1)

global_cell.type.major_minor_patient


3.2 Cell counts

3.2.1 By cell type

barplot_cell_counts_minor =
  ggplot(data =
           xenium@meta.data %>%
           dplyr::group_by(Minor_cell_annotation) %>%
           dplyr::summarise(n = n()) %>%
           dplyr::arrange(desc(n)) %>%
           dplyr::mutate(Minor_cell_annotation = factor(Minor_cell_annotation,
                                                             levels = unique(Minor_cell_annotation))),
         aes(x = Minor_cell_annotation,
             y = n,
             fill = Minor_cell_annotation)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = NA) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors_cell_type_minor) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0)) +
  xlab(NULL) +
  ylab("Number of cells") +
  ggpubr::theme_pubr(legend = "none") +
  theme(axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))


stack_plot_major =
  ggplot(data =
           xenium@meta.data %>%
           dplyr::group_by(Major_cell_annotation) %>%
           dplyr::summarise(n = n()) %>%
           dplyr::arrange(n) %>%
           dplyr::mutate(Major_cell_annotation = factor(Major_cell_annotation,
                                                          levels = unique(Major_cell_annotation)),
                         n.label = factor(as.character(n), levels = as.character(n))),
         aes(x = "All cells",
             y = n / 10^3,
             fill = Major_cell_annotation,
             label = n.label)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors_cell_type_major, name = "Cell type (major)") +
  geom_text(position = position_stack(vjust=0.5), size = 2) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0)) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0.5,0)) +
  ylab("Number of cells (x10<sup>3</sup>)") +
  xlab(NULL) +
  ggpubr::theme_pubr(legend = "right") +
  theme(axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.line.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = ggtext::element_markdown())
  

patchwork::wrap_plots(stack_plot_major, barplot_cell_counts_minor, nrow = 1, widths = c(0.5,1))

stack_plot_tissue_type =

        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.line.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = ggtext::element_markdown())
  

patchwork::wrap_plots(stack_plot_tissue_type, barplot_cell_counts_tissue_type, nrow = 1, widths = c(0.2,1))
